deviations_from_card: Three commits, not four: the card's feat(cert) certGap-with-no-caller commit and the feat(linga) steering commit are one commit (6582f07d), because certGap has no honest test seam without the steering that reads it. Plate carries a new optional field hero.open (view.ts, OpenDoor Plate, LingaTV, linga.css) as the card describes; the TV renders the open slots as dashed outlined chips under a 'Still to show' label (the card's 'dashed-path grammar' was read as the dashed outline of the Stones, not as the Stones row itself). New exports in cert.ts beyond certGap: recommendFor (the wrapper the card allowed, so callers keep one import) and shownSkills (the shown skills with spoken or written, from the same evidence issue() would print). recommendScene in curriculum.ts gained a defaulted third argument 'open'. Case 8 (the capture) was run by the builder, not left to the operator. Case 6's 'my-certificate' door for a hand-picked learner is a nav to linga-cert and for a learner holding a certificate it stays the cert-open command as before. Counting: the 8 acceptance cases are cert 16-22 plus the revised cert 14 row (case 6 spans cert 21 and the cert 14 row); cert 19 is the guard (case 4); 7 tests red before (cert 14, 16, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22), the sixth and seventh acceptance cases 5/6/7 and 1/2/3 among them; case 8 is the capture.
notes: User-visible behaviour changes the card did not list: (1) a learner whose latest check was read with LOW confidence (not hand-picked) is a blocker 'low' and also gets the outline with no slots, Find my level, and the caption 'Your last check was a mixed read, so take it again another day for a firmer one.' (the card named only the hand-picked case). (2) A learner with a valid check and every required skill shown but no certificate yet (blocker null, open empty) sees the outline with caption 'Linga issues it when you next finish a conversation.' and 'Not issued yet' in the arch tag; only reachable between the last evidence and the next issue point. (3) The outline's caption tag is 'What it needs' (the issued plate keeps 'How it was issued'). (4) A learner with a held certificate for the band and requirement has gap open [] so the steering is off for them: plan-done 'Talk again' is the old behaviour. (5) Steering only applies once every plan topic is started and only to a plan with at least one topic; with no plan, recommendScene's no-plan path is untouched (open is ignored there), so a plan-less learner is not steered. Each of these is a read-time derivation; no stored shape changed. Disagreements with the scout: none of substance. The built-in 'date' scene is excluded from steering unless it is already a plan topic (it is only offered on request elsewhere in recommendScene). Observation worth the owner's eye: check.ts:159 still lets a plan span only four skills, so a B1 plan can still leave two open skills; the card's steering makes the next scene cover them but a plan that names them from the start is still not required.
